paragraphs: IER presents itself as a supplier working alongside public and private organizations. The stated work is connecting and automating the movement of passengers and of goods.

On the goods side, an asset management service follows reusable containers through storage, distribution, shipping, maintenance and return. Each container carries an RFID tag with a QR code, so it can be identified and its states and locations traced. On the airport side the site presents Skycheck from EASIER, a self-service check-in kiosk. It lets travelers check themselves in and print boarding passes and baggage tags. The kiosk is described as compatible with CUSS 1.5 and 2.0 and with biometrics, in a fixed or battery-powered portable version.

The company describes its own strength as expertise in technology, production and integration for demanding operating environments. Service coverage is described as worldwide, supported by many locations. Support is delivered either by IER subsidiaries or through a network of selected local partners.

quote.text: IER offre à ses clients une expertise unique en matière de technologie, de production et d’intégration.
